briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek-R2 escalate multi-agent AGI capabilities amid regulatory scrutiny

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race intensifies as frontier labs release advanced reasoning models while safety gaps widen. Prompt injection attacks continue to dominate production deployments. Global compute buildout accelerates with new hyperscale clusters coming online.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys o4 with native multi-agent orchestration. Anthropic ships Claude 4 Opus. DeepSeek-R2 matches GPT-4o performance at 30% lower inference cost. Meta open-sources Llama 4 400B variant.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 1.2M units monthly. Microsoft and Google announce joint 500MW data center campus in Texas. xAI activates Phase 3 of Memphis Colossus cluster.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will protocol-level dialect negotiation become mandatory for all frontier model deployments by 2028?
